achievements.heading: Refund reconciliation, built to scale
achievements.description: Designed batch reconciliation on Apache Flink that matches merchant refunds to disputed transactions and resumes eligible workflows without a live Ledger lookup for every transaction.

achievements.heading: One outcome, even on retry
achievements.description: Redesigned dispute and claim creation to be idempotent and retry-safe, preventing duplicate or inconsistent financial records after partial failures.

achievements.heading: The full Mastercard dispute lifecycle
achievements.description: Implemented the flow from representment to arbitration and replaced hard-coded business rules with configurable workflows.

achievements.heading: A trace across the network
achievements.description: Rolled out OpenTelemetry tracing across Visa, Mastercard and RuPay services so production requests can be followed between repositories.

achievements.heading: Testing as a team practice
achievements.description: Established AI-assisted unit testing for the dispute module; the team later adopted the approach and raised overall coverage beyond 90%.

achievements.heading: A leaner payments foundation
achievements.description: Removed a legacy Gateway Commons dependency across the UPI services, improving modularity and build stability.

achievements.heading: Less waiting at validation
achievements.description: Introduced caching in VPA validation flows to reduce transaction latency.

achievements.heading: Security fixes, shipped
achievements.description: Resolved critical vulnerabilities identified with Snyk across UPI services.

achievements.heading: Rules that protect each payment
achievements.description: Implemented merchant category restrictions and transaction caps, and relaxed over-strict QR validation to improve scan success.
